description: Property identifier. If the input file had an `aoi_id` column it is preserved; otherwise generated from row index (0-indexed).
Area of the building, in square metres.
Count of linked child roofs.
JSON list of all roofs linked to this building, sorted by IoU (Intersection over Union) descending. Each item: `{feature_id, iou}`.
The unique ID for the class of this feature.
Area of the building clipped to the parcel boundary, in square metres.
Confidence in detection of the building (single feature, not combined).
A description of the class of this feature.
Feature ID of the building.
Quality of the shape of the vectorized footprint polygon (and implicitly the accuracy of the area measurement).
Whether this feature is the parcel's primary feature for its class — selected by the largest-intersection strategy (see README → Primary Feature Selection).
URL to view this row in Nearmap MapBrowser. Per-class files (roof, building, etc.) frame the URL on each feature's centroid; the rollup frames it on the parcel.

Date of the 3D mesh used for 3D attributes (height, pitch, etc.). The mesh is usually comprised of a number of overlapping surveys captured at a similar time of year, so this date represents that capture window rather than a single survey.
Area of the dominant material component on the primary roof (primary linked roof).
Confidence in the dominant material classification (primary linked roof).
Snake_case name of the dominant material feature class (`unknown` when ratio < 0.5). Open-ended; consult the Feature API class registry for the full list of possible values (primary linked roof).
Feature class UUID of the dominant roof material. Dominant = highest-ratio component; UNKNOWN (null) when ratio < 0.5 (primary linked roof).
Ratio of the dominant material relative to total roof area (primary linked roof).
Area of the dominant shape component on the primary roof (primary linked roof).
Confidence in the dominant shape classification (primary linked roof).

Snake_case name of the dominant shape feature class (`unknown` when no detected area). Open-ended; consult the Feature API class registry for the full list of possible values. Excludes deprecated flat roof and `shed` (primary linked roof).
Feature class UUID of the dominant roof shape. Dominant = highest-ratio component; UNKNOWN (null) when no detected area (primary linked roof).
Total area of gable detected on the primary child roof of the parent feature, in square metres.

Confidence in gable classification on the primary child roof of the parent feature. When multiple detections contribute: top-level feature classes on the parcel (e.g. all roofs, all vegetation segments) are combined so confidence rises with corroborating detections; sub-attributes within a parent feature (e.g. staining on a roof) take the maximum across detections. Null when the corresponding area is 0.
